{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Hunter}}
{{Quote|I hope there's nothing out there that's particularly hungry.''"<br />"''I wouldn't count on that. But from what I know about Rodia, the locals have hunted all the big beasties to near extinction.|[[Shella Rinou]] and [[Kelric (Herglic)|Kelric]]|<ref name="A Brief Visit to Rodia">{{WEGCite|story=A Brief Visit to Rodia|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>}}
[[File:HK-55_on_the_Hunt.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Hunter Droid pursues its prey.]]
'''Hunting''' was the action of trapping or killing creatures. Hunting was often a leisure sport on civilized planets but a necessary skill for survival on primitive worlds. Often the hunted quarry would be used for food or [[Clothing/Legends|apparel]]. Those who hunted large creatures were known as [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]]. On some planets with deeply traditional cultural system, such as [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], hunting certain creatures was a sacred rite. Those who hunted sentient life-forms were known as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].

On Kashyyyk, young [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warriors would single-handedly hunt the [[Katarn/Legends|Katarn]], a quick and deadly creature, to prove their worth. On the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] would venture out from their treetop villages to the forest floor to hunt for food. They used a variety of hunting methods to catch prey including traps.<ref name="SWE Ewoks">{{SWE|groups|ewoks|Ewoks}}</ref>

While living on Tatooine, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used his [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] to hunt [[womp rat/Legends|womp rats]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], when another [[Rebel Alliance/Legends|Rebel]] pilot protested during [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Dodonna]]'s attack plan briefing in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] that the two-[[meter]] target on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] was impossible to hit even for a [[computer/Legends|computer]], Skywalker countered that he used to "bulls-eye" womp rats that were not much bigger than two meters.<ref name="StarWarsNovelization">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="ANewHope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
